remarks: This beautifully designed 2-bedroom townhouse features quality craftsmanship throughout and is privately set at the back of the complex. A spacious foyer with a double closet provides direct access to the oversized two-car garage. The main level is filled with natural light and offers an easy, open flow-complete with a living room that opens to a deck overlooking the grounds. The large dining room, highlighted by a lighted tray ceiling, connects seamlessly to the kitchen with maple cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. A powder room completes the main floor. Upstairs, the generous primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a luxurious bath with double sinks, marble counters and flooring, a jacuzzi tub, and a separate shower. Laundry is conveniently located on the second floor.
